spec_match.rationale: Exercises the real web-facing surface the feature rides on: Notification.permission, Notification.requestPermission(), new Notification() with show/click/close/error events, navigator.permissions.query({name:'notifications'}) with onchange, and display-mode media queries for installed-PWA detection; the OS-side attribution itself is correctly framed as unobservable from JS.

interactive.rationale: Query/request/show buttons call the actual APIs and stream results into a JSON readout, an event log, and live status lines; the verdict button recomputes the honest attribution conclusion for the current environment.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises a real-API probe with an honest prerequisite checklist; both are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles API-missing, permission default/denied (including the headless auto-deny note), constructor throw (SW-only platforms), permission change events, and the not-probeable flag marked MANUAL rather than guessed.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5863296436666368 and the WHATWG Notifications spec.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite mirrors these contracts (permission enum, permissions.query state, requireInteraction member, badging methods, display-mode uniqueness) and verified 8 pass / 0 fail / 1 blocked-manual on this browser; the manual assertion honestly records the OS-visual contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 desktop+true-360 verified: checklist renders 2 NOT MET (macOS, installed PWA) + MANUAL flag row, readout shows constructorPermission=default / permissionsQuery=prompt, show-notification produces the honest cannot-show message, console clean, 0 overflow; the granted-permission path (real banner + events) cannot be exercised headless and needs a manual run.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the permission enum and prerequisite render, and reports show-fallback separately (notif-probe-show-fallback-honest) so a blocked notification is never a fake pass.

design_system.rationale: Checklist marks use accent-emerald/rose/amber on paper (AA), statuses on bg-stone with black text, CSS variables throughout, no static cards.

accessibility.rationale: Checklist is a labelled list with text verdicts (not colour-only — MET/NOT MET/MANUAL words), aria-live polite statuses, labelled readout pre, native buttons with focus-visible.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280x1800 and a true 360px viewport (iframe harness): the long inline API code token that measured 116px of overflow was fixed with code{overflow-wrap:anywhere} + .lab>*{min-width:0}; re-measured 0px overflow, buttons stack full-width, checklist rows wrap.

guidanceConsulted.query: notification permission request user gesture honest fallback unsupported feature detection
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Surface state changes as text in live regions and never communicate status by colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every probe result lands in an aria-live polite output; checklist verdicts are literal MET/NOT MET/MANUAL words with colour as reinforcement.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid children need min-width:0; long unbreakable tokens need overflow-wrap so intrinsic min-content cannot widen the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied after the iframe-harness measured 116px overflow at 360 caused by the inline permissions.query code token; re-measured to 0.

guidanceConsulted.query: notification permission request user gesture honest fallback unsupported feature detection
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Permission-gated actions belong behind explicit user-gesture buttons with clear outcome messaging.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: requestPermission and show-notification run only from button activation and report the resolved state verbatim, including the headless auto-deny explanation.

openQuestions.title: Manual verification on real macOS with the flag enabled
openQuestions.detail: The full success path — grant permission, show a notification from an installed PWA, observe App Shim attribution in Notification Center — requires macOS + Chrome 130+ + installed PWA + chrome://flags/#enable-mac-pwas-notification-attribution and a human. This Linux sandbox can only verify the honest negative branches.

openQuestions.title: Add a service-worker showNotification variant
openQuestions.detail: Page-context new Notification() throws on some platforms (Android) where only ServiceWorkerRegistration.showNotification works, and installed-PWA notifications in production overwhelmingly come from service workers. A SW-based concept would exercise the path the attribution feature actually targets most.

summary: Real Notification/Permissions API probe with an honest per-device prerequisite checklist (macOS NOT MET, installed PWA NOT MET, flag MANUAL in this sandbox) and a computed attribution verdict. Verified in headless Chromium 141 on desktop and a true 360px viewport: correct readouts, honest cannot-show fallback, clean console, zero overflow; conformance suite 8 pass / 1 blocked here.
